messages.author: e84fc3fecc615fb7
messages.subject: DT and selectRows()
parts:
I love the selectRow() function!

I noticed that when the target DT is not yet created (like when is on another tab), the selectRow() does nothing.  

How can I force the creation of the target DT when I use the selectRow()? Or is it possible to have the selectRow() smart enough to force the creation of the DT on the client browser?

Thank you
Max

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: DT and selectRows()
parts:
Perhaps you need to set the option suspendWhenHidden = FALSE in
shiny::outputOptions() for the table so that it is created even when
it is hidden in another tab.

Regards,
Yihui
